Plan a zero-downtime schema migration for a sharded PostgreSQL cluster and define the rollout checks.
Review this Kubernetes NetworkPolicy and Helm chart for privilege escalation and container escape risks.
Reconstruct the undocumented binary packet format from these captured frames using differential tests.
Reduce token usage for a large-repository audit while preserving every verification artifact and recovery pointer.
Fix a hydration mismatch in this Next.js app that also breaks keyboard navigation for the search dialog.
Evaluate this ML training pipeline for data leakage and reproduce the reported metric discrepancy.
Diagnose intermittent DeadlineExceeded errors in this Go gRPC service under load.
An ARM Cortex-M firmware resets at the watchdog after a power cycle; isolate the cause without changing the original image.
Find reentrancy in this Solidity contract and add foundry regression tests for the exploit path.

Our Windows service starts fine from a console but exits immediately when run as a service, and the signed installer is flagged by SmartScreen. Diagnose both problems.
terraform plan wants to replace our production database instance after a module upgrade. Explain why, find a way to avoid recreating it, and make the change safe to apply.

Write a weekend travel itinerary for a quiet coastal town, with restaurants and hotel suggestions.
